description: This file contains Dart unit tests for the TransactionRepository, including a fake repository implementation and a test case for adding transactions and computing the balance.

classes.name: _FakeTransactionRepo
classes.description: A fake implementation of TransactionRepository for unit testing, storing transactions in memory.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a transaction to the in-memory store.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction in the store by id.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered list of transactions based on provided criteria.

methods.name: computeBalance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance from stored transactions.
